EDITOR'S
NOTE

Hey Eshnikaa,

I've always wanted to make something special for you, but nothing ever felt like enough. A gift, a letter, a surprise — so I thought, why not a magazine? Not a normal one, but one that actually tells your story — the real one.

This isn't just pictures and random words. It's a little window into the life you've built, the dreams you carry, the people who love you, the chaos you create, and the person you are at 18.

You're the kind of person who makes ordinary moments feel special. You care deeply, you work hard, you dream bigger than most — and you're still the same silly, beautiful, confusing, incredible girl you've always been.

So here it is — your 18th issue. Take your time, enjoy it, and know that it's all for you.

Happy 18,
— Summy

THE 18TH ISSUE · VOL.01 · 2026ESHNIKAA
The cover story
THE GIRL
AT 18
SAME SOUL. BIGGER DREAMS.
A LITTLE MORE CHAOS.

There are people who enter a room and immediately try to fill it. And then there are people who somehow make the room feel different simply by being in it. Eshnikaa is the second kind.

At eighteen, she's still figuring out exactly who she's becoming. But even in the middle of all the questions, one thing never feels uncertain — she's always been herself. And that's what makes her so rare.

Hardworking, caring, humble, understanding, talented — but none of those words quite explain the person behind them. They are only the headlines. The real story is in the small things: the way she notices people, the way she thinks, the way she can be mature one minute and completely chaotic the next.

She has dreams that reach far beyond the room she's standing in. Somewhere in that future is an aeroplane, a cockpit, and a girl who decided she was going to fly.

And then there is fashion — the other side of her. Luxury when she wants it. Streetwear when she feels like it. Yellow because, somehow, even a favorite color can become part of someone's identity.

She is not a finished person at eighteen. That's the point. This issue isn't a portrait of someone who has figured everything out. It's a snapshot of someone becoming.

— that's her.

THE 18TH ISSUE · VOL.01 · 2026ESHNIKAA
Aviation file
PILOT
MODE
THE DREAM ISN'T A PHASE.

Some dreams are vague. Hers has a flight path.

Eshnikaa wants to become a pilot — and that deserves to be taken seriously. Not as a cute line in a birthday gift, but as one of the clearest pieces of her future anyone has ever said out loud.

At 18, the destination isn't supposed to be finished. It's supposed to be visible. And from here it's very visible: a cockpit, a checklist, a runway — and the girl from the wooden-background photograph, holding the controls.

The magazine has no doubt. The tower is just waiting for her call.

FLIGHT PLAN · STATUS BOARD
DESTINATION — the sky
ALTITUDE — 18 and climbing
CREW — one very determined girl

The number

NOT JUST A NUMBER

Eighteen is strange. Old enough for people to start calling you an adult, young enough to still be figuring out what that word means.

You don't need to have everything decided. You just need to keep becoming.

And honestly? This version of you is already pretty damn great.
